title: Show export product field completeness
description: Add a development-only read-only product master-data completeness worksheet for fields already used by export documentation: English declaration name, packing unit and quantity, outer dimensions/weight, and refund-rate entry. Report field presence and gaps only, never a legal customs eligibility or tax-refund conclusion. Do not fetch images or change products, documents or declarations. No migration, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible data action, secret change or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated bounded GET worksheet filters active products by code/name and completeness group, with stable paging and no external lookups.
Each product reports present/missing values for the existing export and packing fields, distinguishing zero, blank and unknown without inventing a legal pass/fail decision.
The product page opens a read-only completeness worksheet with per-field gaps and direct product identity for follow-up through existing edit flow.
Focused unit tests cover sparse and complete products, invalid dimensions, soft deletion, paging and no-write behavior; safe Release validation passes and field rules are documented.
